_comment: Where correlations are sent. Config, not data — it lives in the repo so a routing change is a reviewable commit, the same rule the SLO file follows. Set enabled:false or delete a destination to stop it; nothing is deleted from history.

destinations.note: Generic JSON. Point this at PagerDuty Events v2, Opsgenie, or any receiver.
Paste an incoming-webhook URL. Only criticals by default — an alert channel that fires on warnings gets muted within a week.
